llm_response.reason: The site exhibits hallmark features of scam retail sites, including very low prices and extreme discounts (up to 69% off), 'free shipping worldwide' claims, incoherent and unrealistic product mix, demo/template presentation with incongruent branding, and lack of specific or legitimate business contact information. The only hyperlinks are to generic social media (not actual business pages). There are no trustworthy business IDs, contact addresses, or support details displayed. These red flags fit multiple criteria of Fake Online Shopping scams.
